about: Every resume of the route from a chapter save finishes, except these halts (tools/resume_check.py; docs/campaign/CAMPAIGN_RUNNER.md#the-runner). Each entry is one halt, where and how it stops (chapter, objective index, objective kind, halt kind, and for a lost battle the battle: event:N or random), the chapters whose resume reaches it, the issue that owns it and the date it was recorded. An unlisted halt fails the check, and so does a listed resume that no longer halts there.

halts.note: Xe-A-Thoul (event battle 14) defeats the party: 2 of the resumes that reach him
bioplant_survival RUNs every round whatever the escape odds; four failed runs in encounters 191 and 183 wipe the party

a single Edge encounter (formations 475 and 497) defeats the party at levels 46-49 before the refuge can run; since #173's Megid grant the probe of this chapter from rykros-departure's save completes 40 of 40 trials (Wilson 95% lower bound 0.912), so these streams are the ones the training itself loses

the Profound Darkness (event battle 26) at the edge-training target, every member at level 61 or above: the same-save 100-trial probes after #173's Megid grant win 92/100 with Megid and 97/100 without (Wilson 95% lower bounds 0.850 and 0.915), a difference within sampling with the same early-wipe class, so these resume losses are #171's, not a Megid valuation defect (#178 closed as premise-corrected)

run_then_win RUNs every round whatever the escape odds: the Ice Digger (960 HP) fails three runs from four PROTECTBITs (formation 129) on Dezolis and is destroyed, the class #138 records for bioplant_survival
